seoTitle: How to Add Google Calendar to Notion (Embed & Link)
metaDescription: Learn how to embed Google Calendar in a Notion page, link it to a database, and import events so scheduling and tasks live in one dashboard.
intro: If you plan your day in Google Calendar but manage projects in Notion, keeping the two in sync can save you a lot of tab-switching. This guide walks through embedding your Google Calendar directly inside a Notion page or dashboard and connecting it to a database so your events and tasks stay visible in one place.

steps.heading: Get your Google Calendar's embed link
steps.body: Open Google Calendar settings and grab the public or shareable embed URL for the calendar you want to bring into Notion.

steps.heading: Embed the calendar in a Notion page
steps.body: Use Notion's embed block and paste the Google Calendar link so the calendar view appears live inside your page.

steps.heading: Add the embed to your dashboard
steps.body: Place the embedded calendar alongside your other dashboard widgets so scheduling is visible next to your tasks and projects.

steps.heading: Link events to a Notion database
steps.body: Connect relevant events to entries in a Notion database so tasks and deadlines reference the same dates shown on your calendar.

steps.heading: Import recurring events as needed
steps.body: For events you want to track as database items rather than just view, manually add them as rows so they carry properties like status or owner.

faq.question: Does the embedded calendar update automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, since it's an embed of your live Google Calendar, changes you make in Google Calendar reflect in the Notion embed automatically.

faq.question: Can I edit events directly from Notion?
faq.answer: No, the embed is a view-only window into Google Calendar; you'll need to open Google Calendar itself to edit events.

faq.question: Is this integration free?
faq.answer: Yes, embedding a Google Calendar link into Notion doesn't require any paid app or plugin.

faq.question: Can I embed multiple calendars in one dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add multiple embed blocks, one for each calendar, anywhere on your Notion dashboard.
